title: Runs held by an auto-rebuild resume on their own
lead: A run that the S431 drain held, or that was paused between roles when the auto-rebuild restarted the daemon, carries a record marker; the successor daemon retries each marked run once at start and clears the marker, so no owner action follows a rebuild.
findings_note: 2026-11-18, S431 implementer: after the drain, the successor daemon recovers runs through today's recovery (`internal/engine/recover.go:119`), which pauses each as interrupted until the owner runs `ork retry RUN`. Owner decision adj 467 (`selfhost.auto-rebuild-resume`): mark runs held at a rebuild in their record, and have the successor retry them at start with no owner action.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: The goal of S431 (adj 464) is a rebuild with no hand command. Without this, every held run waits for the owner after each rebuild (adj 467).

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `internal/runrec/` (record marker for a run held by a rebuild)
- `internal/daemon/build.go` (set the marker when the drain holds a run)
- `internal/daemon/runs.go` (at start, retry marked runs once and clear the marker)
- `internal/engine/recover.go:119`
- `internal/daemon/runs_test.go`
- `docs/design.md` (self-host rebuild section, adj 467)

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- `TestRebuildHeldRunResumesAtStart` in `internal/daemon/runs_test.go`: a record with the rebuild marker in state paused (interrupted) is retried once by a new daemon at start, ends in its prior stage, and the marker is cleared.
- `TestUnmarkedInterruptedRunStillWaits`: a record paused as interrupted without the marker is not retried at start (today's behaviour).
- `TestRebuildMarkerRetriedOnlyOnce`: a marked run whose retry fails is not retried again at the next start.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Write the failing tests and see them red for the stated reason.
2. Add the marker to the run record; S431's drain sets it on every run it holds or that has no role running at the restart.
3. At daemon start, after recovery, retry each marked run once (as `ork retry RUN` does), then clear the marker whatever the result.
4. Docs: `docs/design.md` self-host rebuild section, citing adj 467. Changelog entry with `slicer changelog add`.

Owner decisions (2026-11-18): Which runs does the rebuild drain mark for auto-resume? -> held only: mark only a run whose role start waits at the hold (`Engine.HeldForRebuild()`, `internal/engine/hold.go:142`) when the daemon ends. Queued runs, runs paused for the owner (question, shape, budget, lost, earlier interrupt) and runs awaiting approval stay unmarked and keep waiting for the owner..

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
Acceptance criteria:
- After an auto-rebuild, every run the drain held continues on the new daemon with no owner command.
- An interrupted run that the rebuild did not hold still waits for the owner.
- A marked run is retried at most once.

Commands:
- `go test ./internal/daemon -run 'TestRebuildHeldRunResumesAtStart|TestUnmarkedInterruptedRunStillWaits|TestRebuildMarkerRetriedOnlyOnce' -v`
- `go vet ./...`
- `go test ./...`
- `gofmt -l .` must print nothing.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: One commit on the slice branch, message "Runs held by an auto-rebuild resume on their own".
